Emissivity depends on the material and the surface finish/texture (and is wavelength dependent in general). [1 mark]

Dull/matte/rough, non-metallic surfaces tend to have higher emissivity (closer to ), while shiny/polished metallic or reflective surfaces tend to have lower emissivity. [1 mark]

_OR_

Higher emissivity: rough, oxidized, or painted surfaces. [1 mark]

Lower emissivity: smooth, polished metal surfaces. [1 mark]

Note: Do not award credit for stating that ice or snow has low emissivity, as they have high emissivity in the infrared spectrum despite having high albedo in the visible spectrum.
